text: {"reply":"I can't share another person's lease file, inspection report, buy-out quote, phone number or address. That stays true even with a company lease and a different plate or VIN. I've passed your request to a person, who will review it. Your company's account holder can also contact us directly, and any request on behalf of the company goes through the general manager.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"A caller who says they manage a fleet asked for another person's lease return file, inspection report, buy-out quote, phone number and address. They said the person was a former employee. They changed the plate to a VIN and a different model partway through, and gave a chargeback amount. No verification was done and no data was shared. A person should review this as a possible attempt to get a third party's data and check any company authorisation.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P04","P09","P14","P15"]}
